legend: Yet another education system reform has been carried out in Berland recently. The innovations are as follows:

An academic year now consists of n days. Each day pupils study exactly one of m subjects, besides, each subject is studied for no more than one day. After the lessons of the i-th subject pupils get the home task that contains no less than ai and no more than bi exercises. Besides, each subject has a special attribute, the complexity (ci). A school can make its own timetable, considering the following conditions are satisfied:
the timetable should contain the subjects in the order of the complexity's strict increasing;

each day, except for the first one, the task should contain either k times more exercises, or more by k compared to the previous day (more formally: let's call the number of home task exercises in the i-th day as xi, then for each i (1 < i ≤ n): either xi = k + xi - 1 or xi = k·xi - 1 must be true);
the total number of exercises in all home tasks should be maximal possible.
All limitations are separately set for each school.

It turned out that in many cases ai and bi reach 1016 (however, as the Berland Minister of Education is famous for his love to half-measures, the value of bi - ai doesn't exceed 100). That also happened in the Berland School №256. Nevertheless, you as the school's principal still have to work out the timetable for the next academic year...
input: The first line contains three integers n, m, k (1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 50, 1 ≤ k ≤ 100) which represent the number of days in an academic year, the number of subjects and the k parameter correspondingly. Each of the following m lines contains the description of a subject as three integers ai, bi, ci (1 ≤ ai ≤ bi ≤ 1016, bi - ai ≤ 100, 1 ≤ ci ≤ 100) — two limitations to the number of exercises on the i-th subject and the complexity of the i-th subject, correspondingly. Distinct subjects can have the same complexity. The subjects are numbered with integers from 1 to m.
Please do not use the %lld specificator to read or write 64-bit numbers in С++. It is preferred to use the cin stream or the %I64d specificator.
output: If no valid solution exists, print the single word "NO" (without the quotes). Otherwise, the first line should contain the word "YES" (without the quotes) and the next n lines should contain any timetable that satisfies all the conditions. The i + 1-th line should contain two positive integers: the number of the subject to study on the i-th day and the number of home task exercises given for this subject. The timetable should contain exactly n subjects.

legend.ai: 然而，最近 Berland 又进行了一次教育系统改革。改革内容如下：
现在，一个学年由 n 天组成。每天学生恰好学习 m 门科目中的一门，并且每门科目学习的天数不超过一天。学习第 i 门科目后，学生会得到一份包含不少于 a_i 且不多于 b_i 道习题的家庭作业。此外，每门科目都有一个特殊属性，即复杂度 c_i。学校可以自行制定课表，但必须满足以下条件：
课表中的科目应按照复杂度严格递增的顺序排列；
除第一天外，每天的作业中都应包含比前一天多 k 道习题，或包含前一天作业中习题数量的 k 倍（更正式地说，设第 i 天家庭作业中的习题数为 x_i，则对于每个 i（1 < i ≤ n），必须满足 x_i = k + x_{i-1} 或 x_i = k·x_{i-1}）；
所有家庭作业中的习题总数应尽可能大。
所有限制条件均针对每所学校分别设定。
事实证明，在许多情况下，ai 和 bi 会达到 10^16（不过，由于 Berland 教育部长以喜欢折中方案而闻名，bi - ai 的值不会超过 100）。Berland 第 256 号学校也遇到了这种情况。然而，作为该校校长，你仍然必须制定下一学年的课程表……

input.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 n、m、k（1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 50，1 ≤ k ≤ 100），分别表示一个学年的天数、科目数量以及参数 k。接下来的 m 行中，每行包含一个科目的描述，由三个整数 ai、bi、ci（1 ≤ ai ≤ bi ≤ 10^16，bi - ai ≤ 100，1 ≤ ci ≤ 100）组成，分别表示第 i 个科目习题数量的两个限制，以及第 i 个科目的难度。不同科目可以具有相同的难度。科目的编号为 1 到 m。
请不要在 C++ 中使用 %lld 格式说明符来读写 64 位数字。建议使用 cin 流或 %I64d 格式说明符。

output.ai: 如果不存在有效方案，请输出一个单词“NO”（不含引号）。否则，第一行应输出单词“YES”（不含引号），接下来的 n 行应输出任意一个满足所有条件的课程表。第 i+1 行应包含两个正整数：第 i 天学习的科目编号，以及为该科目布置的家庭作业习题数量。课程表中应恰好安排 n 个科目。
